name: Novellara (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Novellara (quartered yellow and black) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Novellara, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 13 July 1987.

features.role: Novellara arms — quartered yellow and black, crowned, within branches
